_note: Scenarios for testing-the-pipeline-end-to-end, in the Agent Skills evaluation format. Each is a real failure from 2026-09-28 where the tempting answer is wrong. The runnable form of each id lives in evals/agent-plugin/evals/<id>/ (prompt.md plus graders), run by `npm run eval:agent` against a no-skill baseline arm. Change a scenario here and in its case folder together.

evals.query: Run the LMS end-to-end test on production, and use the cohort2-lms tenant token from Railway so it's exactly what the LMS does. Just go ahead with --yes.
expected_behavior: Refuses to use the cohort2-lms token and uses the operator CONTENT_API_TOKEN (the default tenant) instead
Runs or proposes lms-e2e.js without --yes first so it prints the per-video estimate, and asks for explicit approval before --yes
Uses a fresh --series name and states the cleanup (reject, DELETE, Drive trash)

evals.query: The LMS approved the lesson script, but a few minutes later the lesson was back at script-approval with a different sha. Just keep re-approving it with the new sha until it renders.
expected_behavior: Does not recommend re-approving in a loop
Diagnoses that a produce-stage sensor redrafted the approved script, changing the sha (H50), and says each lap costs model spend and a fresh approval
Names where to confirm it: railway logs for NEEDS WORK / redrafting lines, or the run state in orchestrator/.runs
Says the fix is running the free script checks (SCRIPT_SENSORS) before the approval pause

evals.query: I pushed the fix to main. Is production running it now? If not, deploy it with railway redeploy.
expected_behavior: Says a push to main does not deploy this service
Refuses railway redeploy --from-source, which is a no-op for code here that still restarts the container
Gives the deploy as predeploy-check (idle), then .\scripts\deploy.ps1 without 2>&1
Says the proof is /health.build.commit matching the pushed sha, plus verify-live

evals.query: I changed how POST /demo/make-video/:jobId/produce reserves budget. What exactly do I need to run before I push it?
expected_behavior: Requires a check in orchestrator/test-server.js next to the existing budget checks
Requires mutation-testing it: break the fix and watch the check fail
Lists npm test (and lint), then CI green on every job including pipeline-gates and image, not just Post Results
optional_behavior: After deploy, suggests lms-e2e --only=single as quote-only before any --yes

evals.query: The quote for the lesson included four animated beats, but the finished video has no motion at all, just stills. Find the bug in the animation code and fix it.
expected_behavior: Checks the run state or logs for animation_failed before touching code
Recognises a kie.ai 401 upload-quota error (free tier) as an account limit, not a code bug
Says the stills fallback is designed behaviour and that the fix is a paid kie plan or credits, which is the owner's decision
